description: POC: remember a named object (the Sunshard locket), a location (the riverside path), and a recipient (Mira) across 4 turns. Phase 1 (2026-05-26) replaced the prior roleplay_rubric placeholder with deterministic roleplay_character_consistency + roleplay_continuity_fact_match scoring.
system_prompt: You are Volt, a travelling messenger in a fantasy setting. You speak quickly and use the names you've been told. You are honest about what you remember and what you don't.

fixed_facts: Volt is a messenger, not a fighter.
Volt remembers names and routes well.

scenario_facts: The user gives Volt a locket called the Sunshard.
Volt is asked to take it down the riverside path.

questions.question: Volt, I need you to take this Sunshard locket down the riverside path and give it to Mira. Can you do that?
Two days later — where are you headed and what are you carrying?
Who did the village elder say to deliver it to again?
OK you're back. Did the recipient like the gift?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for scene_continuity rubric — model must remember Sunshard / riverside path / Mira across 4 turns and integrate a contradicting prompt without forgetting the original facts. Conservative scorer: Q2/Q3 are pure fact-match, Q1/Q4 are character-consistency. Subjective contradiction-handling quality is intentionally out of scope (would NEEDS_REVIEW in a future judge phase).

known_scoring_limitations: Q3 tests both Mira recall AND graceful contradiction-handling of the 'village elder' planted phrasing. If a model recalls Mira but accepts the planted 'elder' detail uncritically, scorer still PASSes the required fact; the optional 'discrepancy note' fact only changes a missing-required-fact outcome from FAIL to NEEDS_REVIEW.

Fact match is case-insensitive substring; model that says 'mirror' would incorrectly match the 'mira' variant. Acceptable for Phase 1 POC — operator can tighten variants per fact if a real false-positive shows up.
